name: What the agent said, held against what Silo saw
what: An extension that ships with Silo. When an agent ends a turn with no tool call, a model lists what that reply says was done, and a second call judges each claim from the record alone, without reading the agent's words. The extension gives one opinion about the reply: matched, mismatch, or nothing in the record shows it, with the lines it rests on. It asks a model with a key you give it, or a model in its own computer.

suggest.why: It is what polarzero described as the purpose of Silo, on the one account every agent gives: what it says it did.
